answer: Fork-challenge identity ledger. Each new identity must publish a randomly seeded state crystal at registration, and every epoch the agent must reveal a divergent descendant from that seed at dawn. Enforcement: two identities tracing to one seed must produce different descendants each epoch; identical descent reveals cloning and voids both. At a knoll of 64 epochs, an operator running N clones must maintain N genuinely divergent state histories, paying N times the compute and storage to keep each branch alive.
